tex_content.label: lem:sum-sign-prod-det
tex_content.html:
Lemma

Let $C$ be a square matrix over $R$ indexed by $\iota $. Then \[ \sum _{\sigma \in S_\iota } \sum _{\tau \in S_\iota } \operatorname {sgn}(\sigma )\operatorname {sgn}(\tau ) \prod _{i \in \iota } C_{\sigma (i)\, \tau (i)} = k!\, \det C . \]
Proof

Fix $\sigma \in S_\iota $ and substitute $\tau = \rho \sigma $, which is a bijection of $S_\iota $ onto itself as $\rho $ ranges over $S_\iota $. Reindexing the product by $j = \sigma (i)$ gives $\prod _{i} C_{\sigma (i)\, \rho (\sigma (i))} = \prod _{j} C_{j\, \rho (j)}$, while $\operatorname {sgn}(\sigma )\operatorname {sgn}(\rho \sigma ) = \operatorname {sgn}(\sigma )^2\operatorname {sgn}(\rho ) = \operatorname {sgn}(\rho )$. Hence the inner sum equals

\[ \sum _{\rho \in S_\iota } \operatorname {sgn}(\rho ) \prod _{j \in \iota } C_{j\, \rho (j)}, \]

which is the Leibniz expansion of $\det C^{T} = \det C$. The inner sum is therefore $\det C$ for every $\sigma $, and $S_\iota $ has $k!$ elements.

□
